topic: YouTuber (Joselu's channel collaborator) travels Manchester to Qatar to surprise Cristiano Ronaldo with a custom golden football; travel vlog with cold-open teaser
hero: Vlogger/creator (green Adidas jacket, cap) and Cristiano Ronaldo
hero_role: narrator and protagonist of the stunt; Ronaldo is the target
hook: Excited creator points at camera while Ronaldo prepares a penalty behind him
subtitle_style: Bold white sentence subtitles, bottom centre; small red 'RONALDO' name tag text over footage; yellow/white 'COMING NEXT' lower-left label; white bold place-name caption 'DOHA, QATAR'
reaction_overlays: Name labels (red RONALDO, yellow JOSELU), picture-in-picture channel icon, B/W desaturated freeze-style teaser clips, FIFA-card style Joselu pop-up
transition_summary: Fast vlog cuts: about 4-7 cuts per 10 s (23 cuts in 63 s), cold-open teaser montage then travel scenes, hard cuts plus b/w teaser flashes
audio_note: Creator voice-over/vlog speech, natural ambience, background music; transcript starts 'that is Cristiano Ronaldo about to take a penalty right behind me'
